  document "Ideas" 01M40V1RNE8CPZ26WT9V75Y3FY
    created 2026-10-03T12:15:32Z, modified 2026-10-03T12:15:32Z
  document "What protein is" 01M40V1RMQ6BV3ZEZFF3B30A87
    created 2026-10-03T12:15:31Z, modified 2026-10-03T12:15:31Z
    | Protein is built from amino acids[^cite:01M40V1RG7R41CM2ET593GFG66@44]. [^cite:01M40V1RK35T3QJDE9EBJ9G32F!narrative] measured how much of it Finnish adults eat.
    | 
    | # Kinds of protein
    | 
    | Complete proteins contain all nine essential amino acids[^cite:01M40V1RKBAWG1XN9M7T0HJBNP@para:3][^cite:01M40V1RK794PATZ8AEFV6Z7GM]. The requirement is set per kilogram of body weight.[^cite:01M40V1RKBAWG1XN9M7T0HJBNP]
    | A line of its own, inside the same paragraph.
    | 
    | ## Plant protein
    | 
    | ![Amino acids & their chains](amino-acids.png)
    | 
    | See [[01M40V1RMSYHR1CKXZZGB3VCG0]] for what the body does with it. [^cite:01M40V1RKJBW8WF5BNS2XZWKSR@time:1:04:22] shows it being measured, and [^cite:01M40V1RKPVMZ41D32YDVF839H@time:12:30!narrative] talks it through.
    | 
    | Rated 5* online, which *is* not a source. #Not a heading either.
    linked from "How protein is used"
    picture "amino-acids.png": 85 bytes

  topic "In the body" 01M40V1RFZSSM1EDNH88QEFSAC
    document "How protein is used" 01M40V1RMSYHR1CKXZZGB3VCG0
      created 2026-10-03T12:15:31Z, modified 2026-10-03T12:15:31Z
      | Used for tissue repair[^cite:01M40V1RKT03K369MMDFJJWMGN@chapter:3], and as fuel when nothing else is left[^cite:01M40V1RKZMJFNV01TDAYWD6PH@12-14]. Training raises the need[^cite:01M40V1RMEMMJJPEMCB2SG11J2@4].
